name: t-mw/citygen
description: An interactive procedural city generation demo using road network growth algorithms inspired by the 2001 Parish & Muller paper, rendered in the browser. Generates organic and grid street layouts with building footprints.
score_rationale: One of the most faithful open-source implementations of the seminal Parish-Muller city generation algorithm, usable in the browser.
summary: Browser-based city generation implementing Parish-Muller street network algorithm.
